# Operator operator ==

#### operator ==(ElementId, ElementId)

Tells whether two element identifiers are equal.

##### Declaration

```
public static bool operator ==(ElementId inElementId1, ElementId inElementId2)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId1 |  First element identifier.  |  
 
|  ElementId |  inElementId2 |  Second element identifier.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  Element identifiers are equal.  |
